title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENVI - Lamppost
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/Lamppost. A tall pole with a light at the top. Device kind in the Lighting Domain (ETSI TS 103 410-2 clause 6.1.4); subclass of saref:Device. Per the TS: 's4envi:Lamppost belongs to the eponym class s4envi:Lamppost' -- i.e. the OWL class groups both actual Lamppost device instances and the Lamppost DeviceKind individual itself plus narrower device kinds (e.g. ShieldedLamppost).

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Lamppost'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

location.description: GeoProperty. Geolocation of the lamppost, expressed as a GeoJSON Point.

hasLightPoint.description: Relationship. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/hasLightPoint'. A relation between a lamppost and its light points (sub-property of saref:consistsOf). Links to LightPoint entities.

projectsLight.description: Relationship. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/projectsLight'. A relation between a lamppost or a light point and the light (or lights) they might project. Links to Light entities.

usesCommunicationInterface.description: Relationship. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/usesCommunicationInterface'. A relation between a device and the communication interface it uses. Links to a CommunicationInterface entity.

usesCommunicationProtocol.description: Relationship. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/usesCommunicationProtocol'. A relation between a device and the communication protocol it uses. Links to a CommunicationProtocol entity.
